title: Work on A
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (1) is correctly stated as $-\frac{6}{5}mgl$ (or equivalent).

title: Force on B Magnitude
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (2) magnitude is correctly stated as $\frac{3}{5}mg$ (or equivalent).

title: Force on B Direction
description: Essential: The answer correctly identifies the force on B as a pushing force (thrust/compression).

title: Energy Conservation Setup
description: Important: Applies conservation of mechanical energy correctly, relating the change in gravitational potential energy to the final kinetic energies of A and B.

title: Kinematic Constraint
description: Important: Correctly uses the rigid-rod constraint to relate the linear velocities of A and B via the common angular velocity ($v_A = 2v_B$).

title: Work-Energy for A
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem to sphere A separately, considering gravity and the rod's work.

title: Centripetal Force for B
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law to sphere B at the vertical position, setting net radial force equal to $mv_B^2/l$.

title: Sign Error in Work
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns a positive sign to the work done by the rod on A, or misinterprets the sign convention for work.

title: Force Direction Misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly identifies the force on B as a pulling force (tension) instead of a pushing force.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Explicitly includes correct units (e.g., Joules, Newtons) or dimensional consistency in the final answers.
